Quick one — we need to turn on the Advanced Vector Cache add-on for the remainder of our current Redwood billing cycle (activated today). Because the cost needs to be charged to two different internal budgets, can you confirm whether Redwood can: 

- Option A: Issue two pro-rated invoices for the remainder of the month, each covering a portion of the add-on cost and labeled with separate PO numbers (PO1234 for R&D, PO1235 for Clinical)
- Option B: Issue a single pro-rated invoice but split into two line items and allow us to pay with two payment methods/POs (some AP systems want separate invoices)

We also need the invoices to include our VAT/Tax ID and the correct billing contacts:
- PO1234 / R&D AP: ap-rnd@novamed.com / Attn: Peter Kim
- PO1235 / Clinical AP: ap-clinical@novamed.com / Attn: Elisabeth Chong

Attached is the PO for the activation (NovaMed_PO_1234.pdf). Let me know what you need from our side and an ETA for the invoices — AP needs them before EOD Monday to process this cycle.

Thanks,

Hi Elisabeth — thanks for the clear note and PO. We can support both approaches, but there are trade-offs with AP systems and tax handling. Quick summary and what I need from you to proceed: 

What we can do (pick one):
- Two pro-rated invoices (recommended if your AP requires separate invoices per PO). Each invoice will show the prorated service window, its share of the add-on charge, and the relevant PO number and billing contact.
- One invoice with split line items and two PO references (works for systems that accept multiple PO refs on a single invoice). Payments would still need to be coordinated on your side.

What I need from NovaMed to generate the invoices:
- Confirm which option you prefer (Two invoices or Single split invoice)
- Confirm VAT/Tax ID to appear on each invoice (if different billing entities)
- Confirm billing contact email for each invoice (ap-rnd@novamed.com, ap-clinical@novamed.com are noted)

Internal next steps: I’m looping in Monica in Billing to draft the prorated invoice amounts and Evelyn to coordinate account-side tagging so the usage shows correctly in the portal. Ben — flagging this for the deal record (DEAL-4521) so the invoice split is reflected in our reporting.

If we get confirmation today, Monica can issue PDF invoices by tomorrow EOD and we can attach payment instructions or DocuSign as needed.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
+1 650-555-0228
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: grace.oconnor@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai, evelyn.hart@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 10:30:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Request: enable Advanced Vector Cache add-on mid-cycle + split billing — invoices and tax handling

Thanks Grace — ran the numbers based on activation 2026-11-12 09:00 PST and the billing cycle that started 2026-11-01 00:00 PST. Calculations below for the add-on (monthly list price $6,000):

- Remaining days in cycle: 19 days (Nov 12 - Nov 30 inclusive) / 30-day month = 0.6333
- Prorated monthly charge: $6,000 * 0.6333 = $3,800 (rounded)

If NovaMed wants two invoices split by budget, we can allocate by percentage or fixed amounts. Elisabeth requested an even-ish split across two POs. Proposed split:
- Invoice A (PO1234 / R&D): $2,100 (55.3%)
- Invoice B (PO1235 / Clinical): $1,700 (44.7%)

Tax/VAT: I checked the billing entity on file for NovaMed. If the invoice will be issued to the EU entity and you provide a valid EU VAT ID, we will zero-rate VAT and include the VAT ID on the invoice. If the US entity is the billed party, US state sales tax does not apply to this service in CA per our tax guidance — still, we will include the tax registration field for your records.

Deliverables and timeline:
- Option chosen: Two invoices (recommended given AP requirement) — need confirmation from Elisabeth by EOD today.
- Draft PDFs: I will generate invoice_4521-partA.pdf and invoice_4521-partB.pdf within 24 hours of confirmation.
- Payment flow: we can provide either (a) two separate PDF invoices for AP to process OR (b) a single payment link that accepts split payment by PO (requires NovaMed to route funds internally).

Payment methods supported: ACH (preferred), wire, credit card (DocuSign + card link). If they want ACH, please confirm receiving bank details and remittance email. If we need DocuSign to collect card details, I will send the link once invoices are created.

I attached a quick invoice stub with the line-item split for review. Once we have the PO confirmation I will finalize and send to the two AP contacts.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Billing Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai

Great, thank you for the clear options and Monica for the calc. We will proceed with Two invoices (Option A) and the split amounts you proposed are fine — please issue:

- invoice_4521-partA.pdf -> $2,100 -> PO1234 -> ap-rnd@novamed.com (Attn: Peter Kim)
- invoice_4521-partB.pdf -> $1,700 -> PO1235 -> ap-clinical@novamed.com (Attn: Elisabeth Chong)

VAT/Tax ID: use the EU billing entity for PO1234 and include VAT ID EU-987654321. PO1235 is billed to our US clinical entity (no VAT).

We ask for both PDFs to be sent to ap-rnd@novamed.com and ap-clinical@novamed.com and copied to me. AP will aim to process both invoices by next Tuesday; if you can provide the DocuSign credit link we will use that as fallback for faster clearance.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Elisabeth
Finance Director | NovaMed Health
